headline: 今日无新片，IP续作霸榜
headlineEn: No New Releases Today, IP Titles Dominate Trending
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周共3部新片。热搜由《怒之杀》《夜巡毒枭》《末日地堡》《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》等领跑，IP续作与新片话题主导，待映《最后的日出》受关注。
summaryEn: No new films opened today, with only 3 new releases this week. Trending is led by 'Rage Kill', 'Night Patrol: Drug Lord', 'Doomsday Bunker', and 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day', as IP sequels and fresh titles dominate; upcoming 'The Last Sunrise' draws attention.

industryHighlights.text: 今日电影大盘零新片开局，市场热度由存量影片支撑。
industryHighlights.en: No new releases today, with market heat supported by existing titles.

industryHighlights.text: 本周仅3部新片入场，供给端明显清淡。
industryHighlights.en: Only 3 new films open this week, a notably light release slate.

industryHighlights.text: 热门榜单被《绿灯军团》《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》等IP续作/新作包揽。
industryHighlights.en: Top trending lists are dominated by IP sequels/new entries like 'Green Lantern Corps' and 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day'.

industryHighlights.text: 《最后的日出》进入待映名单，引发关注。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming title 'The Last Sunrise' is drawing attention.
